blocks.text: Gap o'rtasidagi ravishlar: always, also, probably, all, both

Ba'zi ravishlar gap oxiriga emas, **o'rtasiga** — fe'l yoniga qo'yiladi. Qizil kitobda chastota ravishlari (always, usually, often, never) shu qoida bilan o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 94-dars). Bu guruh aslida kattaroq: **also**, **just**, **already**, **still**, **even**, **probably**, **certainly**, **definitely**, **really**, **almost**, **nearly**, **hardly**, **only**, shuningdek **all** va **both**. Qoidalar ularning hammasi uchun bir xil. O'zbekchada esa «ham», «balki», «hammasi» erkin harakatlanadi va ko'pincha o'zi tegishli so'zga yopishadi («tennis **ham** o'ynayman»), shuning uchun xatolar ko'p. Bu darsda yangi holatlar: ikki yordamchi fe'l, inkor bilan **probably won't** va **don't really**, qisqa javoblar, **also** va **too**, **maybe** va **probably**.
Ikki yordamchi fe'l: has probably been

Fe'l ikki-uch qismdan iborat bo'lsa (has been done, could have done, will have finished, should have booked), ravish **birinchi** yordamchi fe'ldan keyin turadi: The parcel **has probably been** delivered; You **could easily have** fallen; We **should definitely have** booked earlier. «has been probably delivered» yoki «probably has been delivered» — noto'g'ri yoki noqulay. Bu majhul nisbat (→ 42–43-darslar), modal + have (→ 27–28-darslar) va Future Perfect (→ 24-dars) bilan ko'p uchraydi.

items.text: The flight has **probably** been delayed because of the fog.
You could **easily** have missed the turning in the dark.
items.translation: Qorong'ida burilishni **osongina** o'tkazib yuborishingiz mumkin edi.

items.text: I'll **never** have enough time to read all these books.
items.translation: Bu kitoblarning hammasini o'qishga **hech qachon** vaqtim yetmaydi.

blocks.text: Inkor: probably won't, lekin don't really

Inkor gapda ravishlar ikki guruhga bo'linadi. **probably**, **certainly**, **definitely** inkor yordamchi fe'ldan **oldin** turadi: He **probably won't** come; I **definitely don't** want to move; She **certainly isn't** lazy. «He won't probably come» — xato. **always**, **often**, **usually**, **really** esa inkordan **keyin**: I **don't always** agree; He **doesn't often** call. **really** bilan joy ma'noni o'zgartiradi: I **really don't** like it — umuman yoqmaydi (kuchli), I **don't really** like it — unchalik yoqmaydi (yumshoq, muloyim). **always** bilan ham: It **isn't always** easy — har doim ham oson emas («It always isn't easy» deyilmaydi; «hech qachon» kerak bo'lsa — **never**).

rows: U bilan har doim ham kelisha olmayman.
Bu har doim ham oson emas.

items.text: Oliver **probably won't** get the job — he has no experience.
I **don't really** want to go out tonight, if you don't mind.
items.translation: Qarshi bo'lmasangiz, bugun kechqurun tashqariga chiqqim **unchalik kelmayapti**.

items.text: Being a parent **isn't always** fun, but it's never boring.
items.translation: Ota-ona bo'lish **har doim ham** qiziqarli **emas**, lekin hech qachon zerikarli emas.

blocks.text: also — gap o'rtasida, too va as well — oxirida

**also** («ham», «shuningdek») gap o'rtasidagi ravish: I **also** play tennis; She's **also** a doctor; We've **also** been to Khiva. **too** va **as well** esa gap **oxirida**: I play tennis **too / as well**. O'zbekchadagi «tennis **ham** o'ynayman» ni ko'chirib «I play also tennis» deyish — tipik xato. Inkorda **also** va **too** o'rniga **either** keladi: I don't play tennis **either** (→ qizil kitob, 42-dars). So'zlashuvda **Also,** gap boshida yangi fikr qo'shish uchun ham ishlatiladi: **Also**, don't forget your passport.

items.text: Bekzod plays the piano, and he **also** sings in a choir.
items.translation: Bekzod pianino chaladi, xorda **ham** qo'shiq aytadi.

items.text: Nilufar is a lawyer, and her husband is a lawyer **too**.
We've **also** decided to sell the car and buy bikes.
items.translation: Mashinani sotib, velosiped olishga **ham** qaror qildik.

blocks.text: **all** («hammasi», «hammamiz») va **both** («ikkalasi ham») ham shu o'ringa qo'yiladi: oddiy fe'ldan oldin — We **all** felt tired, They **both** work in banks; be dan keyin — We're **all** ready, They were **both** late; birinchi yordamchidan keyin — The guests have **all** left, We can **both** speak Russian. «We all are ready» — xato, **We're all ready**. Bu ma'noni **all of us**, **both of them** bilan ham aytish mumkin (→ 88–89-darslar): **All of us** felt tired = We **all** felt tired.

items.text: We were **all** shocked by the news about the factory.
My sisters **both** live abroad now, so I miss them a lot.
items.translation: Opa-singillarimning **ikkalasi ham** hozir chet elda yashaydi, ularni juda sog'inaman.

items.text: The tickets have **all** been sold, so we'll watch it online.
items.translation: Chiptalarning **hammasi** sotib bo'lindi, shuning uchun onlayn tomosha qilamiz.

blocks.text: Qisqa javob va urg'u: Yes, I always am

Yordamchi fe'l yoki **be** gapning **oxirida** qolsa (qisqa javob, qarama-qarshilik) yoki urg'u bilan aytilsa, ravish undan **oldin** keladi: Are you tired? — Yes, I **always am**. He says he'll help, but he **never does**. I haven't been to Japan, and I **probably never will**. Kuchaytirish uchun **do / does / did** urg'u bilan: I **really do** like your idea — g'oyangiz menga chindan ham yoqadi.

items.text: Are you hungry again? — I **always am** after the gym!
items.translation: Yana qorning ochmi? — Sport zalidan keyin qornim **doim och**!

items.text: She says she'll stop smoking, but she **never does**.
items.translation: U chekishni tashlayman deydi, lekin **hech qachon tashlamaydi**.

items.text: I've never been late for work, and I **never will** be.
items.translation: Ishga hech qachon kechikmaganman va **hech qachon kechikmayman**.

blocks.text: almost, just, hardly — va maybe / perhaps

**almost / nearly** (sal qoldi, deyarli), **just** (hozirgina; shunchaki), **hardly** (deyarli ... emas, → 101-dars), **only** ham gap o'rtasida turadi: I **almost** missed the bus; We **hardly** know each other. **probably** va **maybe / perhaps** ma'nosi yaqin, lekin o'rni har xil: **probably** — gap o'rtasida (He's **probably** ill), **maybe** va **perhaps** — odatda gap **boshida** (**Maybe** he's ill). O'zbekchadagi «balki» gapning istalgan joyida turaveradi, shuning uchun «He maybe is ill» deb xato qilish oson.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He won't probably come» → He **probably won't** come; «I like also tennis» → I **also** like tennis / I like tennis **too**; «We all are ready» → We're **all** ready; «She always is late» → She's **always** late; «The parcel has been probably delivered» → has **probably** been delivered; «He maybe is ill» → **Maybe** he's ill / He's **probably** ill; «Yes, I am always» → Yes, I **always am**; «I always don't eat meat» → I **never** eat meat.

Uch qadam: (1) gapda yordamchi fe'l bormi? — bo'lsa, ravishni **birinchi** yordamchidan keyin qo'ying; (2) fe'l **be** mi? — undan keyin; (3) oddiy fe'lmi? — undan oldin. Ikki istisno: **probably / definitely** inkordan oldin (probably **won't**); yordamchi gap oxirida qolsa — ravish undan oldin (I **always am**).

Bog'lanish: always / usually / often asoslari — qizil kitob, 94-dars; still, yet, already, any more — 111-dars; even — 112-dars; all of / both of — 88–89-darslar; hardly — 101-dars; fe'l + to'ldiruvchi, joy va vaqt tartibi — 109-dars; ever + Present Perfect — 8-dars.

examples.title: **also** in the middle, **too** at the end
examples.description: **also** — gap o'rtasida (oddiy fe'ldan oldin, be va yordamchidan keyin); **too** / **as well** — gap oxirida.

sentences.text: Aziz is a doctor, and he **also** teaches at the medical university.
sentences.translation: Aziz shifokor, u tibbiyot universitetida **ham** dars beradi.

sentences.text: The hotel has a pool, and it's **also** very close to the beach.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonada basseyn bor, u plyajga **ham** juda yaqin.

sentences.text: We've **also** invited your cousins from Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Samarqanddagi amakivachchalaringni **ham** taklif qildik.

sentences.text: Emma speaks Spanish, and she can **also** read a little Arabic.
sentences.translation: Emma ispancha gapiradi, arabchani **ham** biroz o'qiy oladi.

sentences.text: I'd like a coffee, please, and could I have some water **as well**?
sentences.translation: Bir qahva bering, iltimos, suv **ham** olsam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: This laptop is light, and the battery **also** lasts a long time.
sentences.translation: Bu noutbuk yengil, batareyasi **ham** uzoq chidaydi.

sentences.text: Jasur loves football, and his sister is a big fan **too**.
sentences.translation: Jasur futbolni yaxshi ko'radi, singlisi **ham** ashaddiy muxlis.

sentences.text: The new law will **also** affect small businesses in the region.
sentences.translation: Yangi qonun viloyatdagi kichik bizneslarga **ham** ta'sir qiladi.

sentences.text: You'll need your passport, and you should **also** bring two photos.
sentences.translation: Pasportingiz kerak bo'ladi, ikkita suratni **ham** olib kelishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: Kate not only sings but **also** writes her own songs.
sentences.translation: Keyt nafaqat qo'shiq aytadi, balki qo'shiqlarini o'zi **ham** yozadi.

examples.title: **probably**, **definitely**: **probably won't**
examples.description: **probably**, **definitely**, **certainly** — gap o'rtasida; inkor gapda inkor yordamchi fe'ldan **oldin** (probably won't, definitely doesn't).

sentences.text: It's **probably** going to rain, so take an umbrella.
sentences.translation: **Katta ehtimol bilan** yomg'ir yog'adi, soyabon olib ol.

sentences.text: Tom **probably won't** come to the party — he's working late.
sentences.translation: Tom **ehtimol** ziyofatga **kelmaydi** — kechgacha ishlaydi.

sentences.text: I **definitely** locked the door — I remember doing it.
sentences.translation: Eshikni **aniq** qulfladim — buni qilganimni eslayman.

sentences.text: Madina **certainly isn't** lazy; she just needs more time.
sentences.translation: Madina **aslo dangasa emas**, unga shunchaki ko'proq vaqt kerak.

sentences.text: We **probably don't** need to book a table on a Tuesday.
sentences.translation: Seshanba kuni stol band qilishimiz **ehtimol kerak emas**.

sentences.text: The prices will **definitely** go up after the new tax.
sentences.translation: Yangi soliqdan keyin narxlar **albatta** oshadi.

sentences.text: Bekzod **definitely doesn't** want to work for that company again.
sentences.translation: Bekzod u kompaniyada yana ishlashni **aslo istamaydi**.

sentences.text: You're **probably** right, but let's check the figures anyway.
sentences.translation: **Ehtimol**, haqsiz, lekin baribir raqamlarni tekshirib ko'raylik.

sentences.text: Sarah **certainly** knows how to organise a conference.
sentences.translation: Sara konferensiyani qanday tashkil qilishni **shubhasiz** yaxshi biladi.

sentences.text: If the trains are on strike, we **probably won't** get to Manchester before midnight.
sentences.translation: Agar poyezdlar ish tashlasa, Manchesterga yarim tungacha **ehtimol yetib bora olmaymiz**.

examples.title: **don't really** / **really don't**, **isn't always**
examples.description: always, often, usually, really inkordan **keyin** keladi; **really** ning o'rni ma'noni o'zgartiradi: yumshoq **don't really**, kuchli **really don't**.

sentences.text: I **don't really** like spicy food, but I'll try a little.
sentences.translation: Achchiq ovqat menga **unchalik yoqmaydi**, lekin ozgina tatib ko'raman.

sentences.text: I **really don't** like people who talk during films.
sentences.translation: Film paytida gaplashadigan odamlarni **umuman yoqtirmayman**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **doesn't always** have breakfast because she's in a hurry.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza shoshgani uchun **har doim ham** nonushta **qilmaydi**.

sentences.text: Our boss **doesn't often** praise people, so we were surprised.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'imiz odamlarni **kamdan-kam** maqtaydi, shuning uchun hayron qoldik.

sentences.text: Life in a big city **isn't always** easy for students.
sentences.translation: Katta shaharda hayot talabalar uchun **har doim ham oson emas**.

sentences.text: Jasur **never** drinks coffee after six because it keeps him awake.
sentences.translation: Jasur soat oltidan keyin **hech qachon** qahva **ichmaydi**, chunki uxlay olmay qoladi.

sentences.text: To be honest, I **don't really** understand the new rules.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, yangi qoidalarni **unchalik tushunmayapman**.

sentences.text: Kate **really doesn't** want to move to another city.
sentences.translation: Keyt boshqa shaharga ko'chishni **umuman istamaydi**.

sentences.text: Weather forecasts **aren't always** right, especially in the mountains.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo prognozlari, ayniqsa tog'larda, **har doim ham to'g'ri chiqmaydi**.

sentences.text: We **don't usually** eat out, but today is a special occasion.
sentences.translation: Biz **odatda** tashqarida **ovqatlanmaymiz**, lekin bugun alohida kun.

examples.title: Two auxiliaries: **has probably been**
examples.description: Fe'l bir necha qismdan iborat bo'lsa, ravish **birinchi** yordamchi fe'ldan keyin turadi: has probably been, could easily have, will already have.

sentences.text: The parcel **has probably been** delivered to your neighbour.
sentences.translation: Posilka **ehtimol** qo'shningizga **yetkazib berilgan**.

sentences.text: You **could easily have** hurt yourself on that broken glass.
sentences.translation: O'sha singan shishada **osongina** jarohatlanib **qolishingiz mumkin edi**.

sentences.text: We **should definitely have** booked the tickets earlier.
sentences.translation: Chiptalarni **albatta** ertaroq band **qilishimiz kerak edi**.

sentences.text: By next June, Nilufar **will already have** finished her degree.
sentences.translation: Kelasi iyunga kelib Nilufar o'qishini **allaqachon tugatgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: The problem **has never been** explained properly to the staff.
sentences.translation: Muammo xodimlarga **hech qachon** to'g'ri **tushuntirilmagan**.

sentences.text: They **have often been** criticised for their high prices.
sentences.translation: Ular yuqori narxlari uchun **tez-tez tanqid qilingan**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **would never have** found this job without your help.
sentences.translation: Sizning yordamingizsiz Bekzod bu ishni **hech qachon topa olmas edi**.

sentences.text: The museum **will probably be** closed on the national holiday.
sentences.translation: Milliy bayramda muzey **ehtimol yopiq bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Have you **ever been** asked to give a speech in English?
sentences.translation: Sizdan **hech** ingliz tilida nutq so'zlash **so'ralganmi**?

sentences.text: After two months of repairs, the bridge **has just been** reopened.
sentences.translation: Ikki oylik ta'mirdan keyin ko'prik **hozirgina qayta ochildi**.

examples.title: **all** and **both** in the middle
examples.description: **all** va **both** — oddiy fe'ldan oldin, be dan keyin, birinchi yordamchidan keyin: We **all** agreed, They were **both** late.

sentences.text: We **all** felt nervous before the final exam.
sentences.translation: Yakuniy imtihon oldidan **hammamiz** hayajonlandik.

sentences.text: My parents **both** work in the same hospital in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Ota-onamning **ikkalasi ham** Farg'onadagi bitta shifoxonada ishlaydi.

sentences.text: The guests have **all** left, so we can start cleaning.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlarning **hammasi** ketdi, endi tozalashni boshlasak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Are you **both** coming to the wedding on Saturday?
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni to'yga **ikkalangiz ham** kelasizmi?

sentences.text: The students were **all** surprised by the difficult questions.
sentences.translation: Qiyin savollardan talabalarning **hammasi** hayron qoldi.

sentences.text: Aziz and Jasur can **both** speak Korean quite well.
sentences.translation: **Aziz ham, Jasur ham** koreys tilida ancha yaxshi gapira oladi.

sentences.text: We're **all** looking forward to Nilufar's graduation party next week.
sentences.translation: **Hammamiz** kelasi haftadagi Nilufarning bitiruv kechasini intiqlik bilan kutyapmiz.

sentences.text: Sarah and Emma were **both** born in Manchester, but they met in London.
sentences.translation: Sara **ham**, Emma **ham** Manchesterda tug'ilgan, lekin ular Londonda tanishishgan.

sentences.text: These flats have **all** been sold, I'm afraid.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, bu kvartiralarning **hammasi** sotib bo'lingan.

sentences.text: My colleagues **all** agreed that the new system was slower.
sentences.translation: Hamkasblarimning **hammasi** yangi tizim sekinroq ekaniga qo'shildi.

examples.title: **almost**, **just**, **hardly** and **maybe** at the start
examples.description: almost, nearly, just, hardly, only — gap o'rtasida; **maybe / perhaps** — gap boshida, **probably** — o'rtada.

sentences.text: I **almost** missed my flight because of the traffic.
sentences.translation: Tirbandlik tufayli reysga ulgurmay qolishimga **sal qoldi**.

sentences.text: We'd **just** sat down to dinner when the phone rang.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatga **endigina** o'tirgan edik, telefon jiringlab qoldi.

sentences.text: Bekzod can **hardly** walk after yesterday's football match.
sentences.translation: Kechagi futbol o'yinidan keyin Bekzod **zo'rg'a** yuryapti.

sentences.text: **Maybe** the shop is closed for lunch, so let's come back later.
sentences.translation: **Balki** do'kon tushlikka yopilgandir, keyinroq qaytib kelaylik.

sentences.text: The project is **nearly** finished; we only need to test it.
sentences.translation: Loyiha **deyarli** tugadi, faqat sinab ko'rishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: I was **just** going to call you — what a coincidence!
sentences.translation: **Aynan hozir** sizga qo'ng'iroq qilmoqchi edim — qanday tasodif!

sentences.text: We **hardly ever** see each other since Dilnoza moved to Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza Buxoroga ko'chib ketganidan beri **deyarli ko'rishmaymiz**.

sentences.text: **Perhaps** Oliver didn't get your message — his phone was off.
sentences.translation: **Balki** Oliver xabaringizni olmagandir — telefoni o'chiq edi.

sentences.text: Emma **only** wanted to help, so don't be angry with her.
sentences.translation: Emma **faqat** yordam bermoqchi edi, unga jahl qilmang.

sentences.text: She's **probably** stuck in traffic, or **maybe** she's forgotten about the meeting.
sentences.translation: U **ehtimol** tirbandlikda qolib ketgan yoki **balki** uchrashuvni unutgandir.

examples.title: Short answers: Yes, I **always am**
examples.description: Yordamchi fe'l yoki be gap oxirida qolsa (qisqa javob, qarama-qarshilik), ravish undan **oldin** keladi.

sentences.text: Are you tired? — Yes, I **always am** after a night shift.
sentences.translation: Charchadingmi? — Ha, tungi smenadan keyin **doim shunday**.

sentences.text: Tom says he'll call back, but he **never does**.
sentences.translation: Tom qayta qo'ng'iroq qilaman deydi, lekin **hech qachon qilmaydi**.

sentences.text: I haven't been to Edinburgh, and I **probably never will**.
sentences.translation: Edinburgda bo'lmaganman va **ehtimol hech qachon bormayman**.

sentences.text: Do you still play the piano? — Yes, I **still do**, every evening.
sentences.translation: Hali ham pianino chalasanmi? — Ha, **hali ham chalaman**, har kuni kechqurun.

sentences.text: Is Madina at work? — She **usually is** at this time of day.
sentences.translation: Madina ishdami? — Kunning shu paytida **odatda ishda bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Kate promised to be on time, and she **actually was** for once.
sentences.translation: Keyt vaqtida kelishga va'da bergan edi va bu safar **haqiqatan ham keldi**.

sentences.text: Were the children asleep? — Yes, they **both were**, thank goodness.
sentences.translation: Bolalar uxlab qolishganmidi? — Ha, **ikkalasi ham**, xayriyat.

sentences.text: I know I should exercise more, and I **really do** try.
sentences.translation: Ko'proq mashq qilishim kerakligini bilaman va **chindan ham** harakat qilaman.

sentences.text: Will the shops be open on Sunday? — They **probably will**, but check online.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni do'konlar ochiq bo'ladimi? — **Ehtimol, ochiq bo'ladi**, lekin internetdan tekshiring.

sentences.text: Jasur said he wasn't nervous, but he **obviously was**.
sentences.translation: Jasur hayajonlanmayapman dedi, lekin **hayajonlangani yaqqol ko'rinib turardi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: planning a conference trip
examples.description: Ikki hamkasb konferensiyaga tayyorgarlik haqida gaplashadi: **probably**, **definitely**, **also**, **both**, **never**, **usually is**, **almost**.

sentences.text: — Have you **already** booked the hotel for the conference in Oxford?
sentences.translation: — Oksforddagi konferensiya uchun mehmonxonani **allaqachon** band qildingmi?

sentences.text: — Not yet. The cheap ones have **probably** gone by now.
sentences.translation: — Hali yo'q. Arzonlari **ehtimol** tugab qolgandir.

sentences.text: — We should **definitely** look today, then. Are we **both** going?
sentences.translation: — Unda bugun **albatta** qarashimiz kerak. **Ikkalamiz ham** boramizmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, and Oliver is **also** coming, but he **probably won't** stay for the dinner.
sentences.translation: — Ha, Oliver **ham** keladi, lekin u **ehtimol** kechki ovqatga **qolmaydi**.

sentences.text: — He **never** stays for dinners. He **always** says he's busy.
sentences.translation: — U **hech qachon** kechki ovqatlarga qolmaydi. **Doim** bandman deydi.

sentences.text: — Well, to be fair, he **usually is**. He has three children.
sentences.translation: — Insof bilan aytganda, u **odatda rostdan ham band**. Uchta bolasi bor.

sentences.text: — True. By the way, have you **ever** given a talk in English?
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri. Aytgancha, sen **hech** ingliz tilida ma'ruza qilganmisan?

sentences.text: — Only once, and I **almost** forgot what I wanted to say.
sentences.translation: — Faqat bir marta, o'shanda nima demoqchi bo'lganimni unutishimga **sal qoldi**.

sentences.text: — Don't worry, we can **both** practise together next week.
sentences.translation: — Xavotir olma, kelasi hafta **ikkalamiz** birga mashq qilsak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — Great idea. I **really** need someone to listen and tell me the truth.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r fikr. Menga tinglab, rostini aytadigan odam **juda** kerak.
